items.name: Even in Eagan 2026
items.information:
### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Friday evening* 

##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host 4x4, 6x6, and Square-1 solving.

[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota)
##### ____________________________________

Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space.

items.name: FMC Fall Fürth 2026
items.information:
**Willkommen zur zweiten FMC-Competition in Fürth!**
Die Runden 1+2 werden als Dual Round stattfinden.
Bitte beachtet: Die Venue ist neben einer Kirche mit Glocken. Wenn ihr Empfindlich bei Störungen seid, achtet bitte auf Gehörschutz.

**Welcome to the second FMC-Competition in Fürth!**
The rounds 1+2 will take place as dual rounds.
Please note: The venue is located next to a church with bells. If you are sensitive to noise, please consider bringing hearing protection.

items.name: Kölner Kubing 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYwOTQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03ab56ef962dc6f26d3090cf8b56ad95e1590fc7/Logo.jpeg)

##### **German**
Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum vierten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events!


**English**
Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the fourth time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event!

items.name: Multimatum: New York Multimate PBQ VI 2026
items.information:
This competition only has blind events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in New York](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=New+York&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS COMPETITON HAS SEPARATE REGISTRATION LIMITS FOR EACH EVENT. Please refer to tab titled "Separate Event Registration Limits" for more details. Registrations for each event will be accepted on a first come, first served basis, and a per event waiting list will be managed manually, and will be listed in the Separate Event Registration Limit tab once registration is open.
